entries.title: The Mana-Tombs
body: When the Shadow Council's summoning blew Auchindoun apart, it tore a rift in the Nether that drew the ethereals into Outland. In the northern wing of the ruins, a faction of them under Nexus-Prince Shaffar now drains the arcane energy of the tombs.

entries.title: The Halls of the Void
body: The outer tombs, where the ethereals' servants stand guard: a voidlord armoured in plates, and a colossus of light-blue crystal.

entries.title: The Nexus-Prince's Court
body: The heart of the Mana-Tombs, where Shaffar holds court among his ethereal beacons, and keeps a stasis chamber of his own.

entries.title: Pandemonius
body: A gigantic voidlord clad in armour plates, in the ethereals' service.

entries.title: Tavarok
body: A colossus of light-blue crystal that guards the way through the tombs.

entries.title: Nexus-Prince Shaffar
body: One of the ethereal nexus-princes who rule factions in Outland, rival to Nexus-Prince Haramad of the Consortium. He leads his ethereals in the Mana-Tombs against the Consortium.

entries.title: Yor
body: A void hound Shaffar keeps sealed in his stasis chamber.
